guideTitle: The Best Desk Pad Calendars for Planning at a Glance
metaDescription: Desk pad calendars differ in date range, size and extras like protective film or Julian dates. We compared six on months covered, dimensions, paper and backing.
introParagraphs: A desk pad calendar puts the month in front of you while you work. The first thing to check is the date range: some run a calendar year, while academic-style pads start in June or July 2026 and run 18 or 19 months to December 2027.

Size is next. The 22 x 17-inch pads sit under a keyboard as a working surface; 17 x 12-inch pads sit beside it. Then consider extras: a protective film, a reusable backboard, heavier paper or Julian dates.
Our comparison is based on listed date ranges, sizes and paper specifications, not hands-on testing. Paper surfaces aren't designed for a mouse, so plan to keep a mouse pad alongside.

best-desk-pad-calendars-1.summary: An 18-month, 22 x 17-inch calendar (July 2026 to December 2027) on a reusable PU leather backboard.
best-desk-pad-calendars-1.description:
This calendar pairs a large 22 x 17-inch, 18-month calendar, July 2026 to December 2027, with a reusable double-layer PU leather backboard that protects the desk and can take a new pad later.

It was the most expensive calendar here at the time of writing, reflecting the backboard.
best-desk-pad-calendars-1.bestFor: A long-term planning surface that also protects the desk.
best-desk-pad-calendars-1.skipIf: You only want the paper; the SUNEE is the same size for less.

best-desk-pad-calendars-2.summary: A 17 x 12-inch calendar with 2.3-inch daily squares on 120gsm paper.
best-desk-pad-calendars-2.description:
The Taja is a compact, low-cost calendar: 17 x 12 inches with 2.3 x 2.3-inch daily squares on 120gsm paper, heavier than standard printer paper.

The product name says 2026–2027 but the description refers to 2027; confirm the months covered on the listing.
cons: Sits beside rather than under keyboard
best-desk-pad-calendars-2.bestFor: A monthly planner beside the keyboard.
best-desk-pad-calendars-2.skipIf: You want a pad under your keyboard; the 22 x 17-inch options are larger.

best-desk-pad-calendars-3.summary: AT-A-GLANCE's January to December 2027 desk pad with Julian dates and ruled daily blocks.
best-desk-pad-calendars-3.description:
The AT-A-GLANCE is the calendar-year choice: January to December 2027, with Julian dates and ruled daily blocks, on paper AT-A-GLANCE says resists ink bleed.

It doesn't cover the rest of 2026, so pair it with something else for the remaining months.
best-desk-pad-calendars-3.bestFor: Offices that plan by calendar year or use Julian dates.
best-desk-pad-calendars-3.skipIf: You need the rest of 2026; the 18-month pads start mid-2026.

best-desk-pad-calendars-4.summary: A black-and-white June 2026 to December 2027 calendar for desk or wall.
best-desk-pad-calendars-4.description:
The Aesthetic calendar runs from June 2026 to December 2027 in a minimalist black-and-white design and can hang on a wall as well as sit on a desk.

Its size isn't stated in the listing summary.
best-desk-pad-calendars-4.bestFor: A clean look on a desk or wall.
best-desk-pad-calendars-4.skipIf: You want protective film; the SUNEE has it.

best-desk-pad-calendars-5.summary: A 22 x 17-inch, July 2026 to December 2027 calendar with a transparent protective film.
best-desk-pad-calendars-5.description:
The SUNEE is a large 22 x 17-inch academic-year calendar, July 2026 to December 2027, bound with a transparent film that SUNEE says keeps stains and dust off, with non-bleeding paper.

It costs less than the backboard calendar of the same size at the time of writing.
best-desk-pad-calendars-5.bestFor: A large calendar that stays clean.
best-desk-pad-calendars-5.skipIf: You want a reusable backboard; the first pick includes one.

best-desk-pad-calendars-6.summary: A June 2026 to December 2027 desk or wall calendar with 19 sheets of anti-feathering paper.
best-desk-pad-calendars-6.description:
The GuassLee covers June 2026 to December 2027 on 19 sheets, with paper designed to resist feathering and seepage, and can be used on a desk or wall.

It was tied for the lowest price here at the time of writing. Its size isn't stated in the listing summary.
best-desk-pad-calendars-6.bestFor: The longest range for the least money.
best-desk-pad-calendars-6.skipIf: You want a known size; the SUNEE lists 22 x 17 inches.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Calendar-year (AT-A-GLANCE, 2027) or academic-style from June or July 2026 to December 2027.
22 x 17-inch pads work under a keyboard; 17 x 12 inches sits beside it.
A backboard or protective film keeps the pad and desk cleaner.
Heavier or anti-bleed paper suits pens and markers.

howWeEvaluated.title: Extras
howWeEvaluated.description: We noted backboards, film, Julian dates and paper.

howWeEvaluated.title: Price
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared prices at the time of writing.

faq.a: Calendar-year if you plan January to December; an 18- or 19-month pad if you want to start now or follow an academic year.

faq.q: What size fits under a keyboard?
faq.a: 22 x 17 inches is the common large size; smaller calendars sit beside the keyboard.

faq.q: Can I use a mouse on it?
faq.a: Paper isn't designed for mousing; keep a mouse pad alongside.
Day-of-year numbers used in some scheduling, manufacturing and logistics work. The AT-A-GLANCE includes them.
It protects the desk and can be reused with a new pad.

bottomLine: For a large planning surface, the calendar with a reusable backboard protects the desk long-term, while the SUNEE offers the same size with a protective film for less.
For a calendar year with Julian dates, choose the AT-A-GLANCE. On a small budget, the GuassLee and Taja are the lowest-cost options; confirm their sizes and dates.
